steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We talk about what you need — the occasion, the style you have in mind, the fabric you prefer. Bring your inspiration or rely on our suggestions.

steps.title: Measurements and design
steps.text: We take precise measurements and settle every detail: cut, fabric, lining, buttons, pockets. Nothing is left to guesswork.

steps.title: Making
steps.text: We cut and sew by hand and by machine, paying attention to every seam and every finish.

steps.title: Fitting and delivery
steps.text: At the final fitting we check that everything sits just right. If a small adjustment is needed, we make it on the spot.
